# Syslog remote server
-- syslogs/syslog --
apiVersion: networking.metal.ironcore.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Syslog
metadata:
  name: syslog
  namespace: default
spec:
  deviceRef:
    name: device
  servers:
    - address: 192.0.2.100
      severity: Info

-- state/preload --
{}

-- state/expect --
{
  "openconfig-system:system": {
    "logging": {
      "remote-servers": {
        "remote-server": [
          {
            "config": {
              "host": "192.0.2.100"
            },
            "selectors": {
              "selector": [
                {
                  "facility": "ALL",
                  "severity": "INFORMATIONAL",
                  "config": {
                    "facility": "ALL",
                    "severity": "INFORMATIONAL"
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}

-- state/delete --
{}
